planets.name: L 98-59 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of L 98-59 with a 3.69-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: L 98-59 c was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around L 98-59. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
